issues.description: The disabled/applyDisabled plumbing is effectively dead in rendered output: cards only render in the idle branch where state!=='loading', so the disabled prop is always false where used (the loading branch returns early and removes the buttons entirely). Harmless forward-compat, not a defect — the 'disable apply on loading' requirement is met by removing the buttons. No action required.
